Name: Lance - 1.6 Sprites and Portraits
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
With the 1.6 update, characters got a new set of sprites and portraits for a winter outfit. Given that Stardew Valley Expanded likes to stay well integrated with Stardew Valley, it only makes sense to give that to their characters too. In this case, here is Lance's winter outfit sprites and portraits. This also includes all other regular sprites and portraits with this art style of Lance.

[s]As stated in the overview (and a post on my account), this is not a fully-tested mod. I created this soon enough for after the 1.6 update, but not early enough to be putting it out polished. Some people commented on my post saying they'd be willing to test it, so I'm putting it out now for them and anyone else who would like to help as well.

[/s]I have about almost 200 downloads now, and no one has commented about any bugs or errors so I'm changing this to be an official 1.0 version.

Thank you so much to those who download this to test it out for me, and for anyone else, feel free to track this mod as I update based on feedback.

FOR TRANSPARENCY:
This is NOT all original work of mine, the original portraits/sprites were pulled from (with permission!!!) [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/REI090909]REI090909[/url] (sprites) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72417968]aikeluoxiya[/url] (portraits).

DIRECTIONS:
Portraits: This mod does require Platonymous' Portraiture mod, so be sure to not only install that with this one, but understand how to use it. I did get far enough to integrate with Portraiture due to its resolution.
Sprites: Copy the sprites in the Sprites folder, go to the Stardew Valley Expanded mod and from there follow this folder path: [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\Lance   <-- This is the folder you will paste the sprites into, there will be name conflicts but that's necessary to REPLACE the existing ones so just click the replace option.

Downloads.Description: Make sure to download Portraiture and know how to use it :)
